hooks.command: bash -lc 'set +e; for root in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/plugins/notebook"; do if [ -f "$root/hooks/notebook-context.sh" ]; then exec bash "$root/hooks/notebook-context.sh"; fi; done; shopt -s nullglob; for script in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/notebook/*/hooks/notebook-context.sh "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/notebook/hooks/notebook-context.sh "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*/notebook/hooks/notebook-context.sh "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*/*/hooks/notebook-context.sh; do if [ -f "$script" ]; then exec bash "$script"; fi; done; exit 0'
